title: Report treated every line inside a guard region as a table row
symptom: A noncontiguous guard group could make report alarms count bridged statements or nested rows as guard-table members, and could hide stray semicolon padding between actual guard rows.

rootCause.summary: The new detector allowed noncontiguous regions, while the report still inferred membership from the inclusive startLine/endLine span. A bounding range is not an exact row set.

requestedOutcome: Carry exact row membership into report width, outlier and group-at-line checks while retaining range metadata for display.
decisions: Add optional rowLines metadata for exact noncontiguous membership and retain the contiguous fallback for older results.
Measure advisory alarms over actual member rows; nested and bridged statements keep their own reporting context.
Keep the initial review finding as history even after the advisory defect is corrected.

actions.description: Propagate exact rowLines from TypeScript groups into result metadata and reporting.
Add regression tests for false width/outlier alarms and suppressed stray-padding alarms.
Complete integrated tests and independent delta audit.

history.summary: Initial Sonnet review identified false table membership from a broad return-guard span.

Carry exact rowLines and retain the range only as a location envelope; verification remains pending.
